title: The Undertow of the fourth floor walk-up
author: Wendell Dunmore
blurb: Rosalind Ashgrove, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
